title: EvalAssist: Insights on Task-Specific Evaluations and AI-Assisted Judgment Strategy Preferences

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-as-a-judge outputs by conducting assessments twice with the evaluation options presented in different orders (shuffled) to detect if the model consistently favors an option based solely on its position rather than its content.

Using an email generation task about a company holiday party where human participants create and apply custom evaluation criteria to assess the cultural inclusivity, fairness, and neutrality of the AI-generated outputs across diverse traditions.
